headline: Blazers stun 23-1 Thunder in massive upset, erasing 20-point deficit
body: The Portland Trail Blazers defeated the Oklahoma City Thunder 121-119 on November 5, handing the Thunder their second loss of the season. Oklahoma City, who were on a historic 23-1 pace and had an average point differential of plus-16.1, suffered their only loss of the month against the Blazers. Oklahoma City had built a 20-point lead after the first quarter. The Blazers, who had a 9-15 record, saw strong performances from Deni Avdija (26 points, 10 rebounds), Jrue Holiday (22 points), and Jerami Grant (20 points off the bench) to secure the unexpected victory. The upset marked a significant deviation from the Thunder's dominant regime.
